description: Vectorize every projected flat text field; retain only embeddings

script.source: def inputs = []; def fields = []; for (def entry : ctx.entrySet()) { def field = entry.getKey(); if (['_index', '_id', '_routing', '_version', '_version_type', '_dynamic_templates'].contains(field)) { continue; } if (field.startsWith('_') || field.endsWith('_embedding') || field.contains('.')) { throw new IllegalArgumentException('Reserved or non-flat field: ' + field); } def value = entry.getValue(); if (!(value instanceof String) || value.trim().length() == 0) { throw new IllegalArgumentException('Expected non-empty text for: ' + field); } fields.add(field); inputs.add(['text': value]); } ctx._vector_fields = fields; ctx._vector_inputs = inputs;

for (int i = 0; i < ctx._vector_inputs.size(); i++) { def field = ctx._vector_fields[i]; def vector = ctx._vector_inputs[i].embedding; if (vector == null || vector.size() != 384) { throw new IllegalArgumentException('Missing or invalid embedding for: ' + field); } ctx[field + '_embedding'] = vector; ctx.remove(field); } ctx.remove('_vector_inputs'); ctx.remove('_vector_fields');
